decisions.reason: As a more distant and narrow maritime niche product, it is more likely to fall below aspiration levels and have its resources reallocated to the firm's stronger core lighting lines and new LED developments.
This product builds directly on the firm's industrial lighting capabilities and the 2019 LED replacement-kit update suggests results were good enough to justify continued commitment.

The relaunch of a previously popular task light and its close fit with the firm's professional workplace offer make retention more likely, even if design-led products are reviewed against evolving aspirations.

A pendant office luminaire is close to the established business, matches the firm's energy-efficient LED direction, and an expanding large firm has enough slack to keep it unless performance clearly disappoints.

Although the premium positioning makes it somewhat more exposed if demand undershoots targets, it remains close to the core offer and is still likely to be kept while the firm exploits its established market position.
